title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Maintenance Fee Refund Tool Reference
content:
This operations reference describes the tool that returns a monthly maintenance fee to the Savings & Money Market Accounts product that paid it. It covers what the tool does, how it is reached, what it needs and what it answers.

## What the tool does

`refund_savings_maintenance_fee_bf99bb2f` returns one monthly maintenance fee to the savings or money market account that paid it. A single call writes one refund credit that identifies the maintenance fee concerned and the ground on which it is returned; the account balance goes up by the refunded sum immediately. The credit is dated on the business day it posts, meaning the day of the call if that day is a Monday to Friday outside the Federal Reserve holidays, and otherwise the soonest later day of that kind. Once posted, the credit is listed in the account's activity alongside the fee it reverses.

## Reaching the tool

It is an agent-side tool that is hidden until needed. Unlock it by passing its name to `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`; after that, the agent calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Name | Business meaning | Format or values |
|---|---|---|
| `savings_account_id` | the savings or money market account that was charged | identifier, as the savings account lookup returns it |
| `customer_id` | the account owner | customer reference, as the customer profile lookup returns it |
| `source_item_id` | the monthly maintenance fee entry to be returned | identifier, as the savings activity lookup returns it |
| `amount` | the sum given back | US dollars, positive, rounded to two decimal places |
| `adjustment_reason` | the ground of the refund | one of `courtesy_waiver` (goodwill return of a fee charged correctly), `bank_error` (return of a fee charged contrary to the savings charter), `none` (not a refund ground and never used for one) |
| `statement_cycle` | the statement cycle in which the refund posts | `YYYY-MM`, naming the month in which the cycle holding the refund's posting date closes |

## What it returns

A dictionary shown as text, with the keys `savings_txn_id` (reference of the refund entry), `refunded_fee_id` (the maintenance fee returned), `amount` (two decimals), `adjustment_reason` (the ground recorded), `posted_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and `new_balance` (the balance after the credit, two decimals). A `savings_txn_id` in the answer confirms the refund posted.

## Illustration (hypothetical call)

Called on a Saturday, the tool dates the credit on the following Monday, or on the Tuesday if that Monday is a Federal Reserve holiday, and `statement_cycle` then names the month in which the cycle containing that date closes.

## Contract notes

**Does the tool choose the ground?** No. The ground is whatever `adjustment_reason` carries.

**Can it return a fee other than a maintenance fee?** It is built for the monthly maintenance fee; the entry it writes is coded as a maintenance fee refund.
